metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, were land surface temperatures along the Paris Olympic marathon starting line (Hôtel de Ville) lower than in the Fausses-Reposes forest near Versailles?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature (LST) data for August 6, 2024, around 1:40 pm local time - Paris local time is UTC+2 in summer (CEST) - 1:40 pm CEST = 11:40 UTC - Two locations: Hôtel de Ville (Paris) and Fausses-Reposes forest (near Versailles) - MODIS Terra/Aqua pass times: Terra ~10:30 AM, Aqua ~1:30 PM local - Landsat 8/9: ~10:30 AM local - ECOSTRESS has variable timing and could capture afternoon temps - Best bet: MODIS Aqua (MYD11A1) or ECOSTRESS for afternoon timing 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to mask clouds and invalid pixels - LST is typically in Kelvin, convert to Celsius for validation 3. Logic: - Compare mean LST at Hôtel de Ville vs Fausses-Reposes forest - Valid Zero: LST should be positive (in Kelvin, ~270-330K typical) - If LST_paris < LST_forest: Answer A (Yes) - If LST_paris >= LST_forest: Answer B (No) - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid values) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Hôtel de Ville, Paris (Marathon starting line) paris_point = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566]) paris_roi = paris_point.buffer(500) # 500m buffer # Fausses-Reposes forest (near Versailles) forest_point = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1833, 48.8167]) forest_roi = forest_point.buffer(500) # 500m buffer # August 6, 2024 - looking for afternoon data date_start = '2024-08-06' date_end = '2024-08-07' # 2. Try MODIS Aqua LST (afternoon overpass ~1:30 PM local) modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']) print(f"MODIS Aqua images found: {modis_aqua.size().getInfo()}") if modis_aqua.size().getInfo() == 0: # Try MODIS Terra as fallback modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']) print(f"MODIS Terra images found: {modis_terra.size().getInfo()}") if modis_terra.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No LST data available for August 6, 2024") print("C1") else: collection = modis_terra else: collection = modis_aqua # 3. Process LST data if collection.size().getInfo() > 0: # Get the image lst_img = collection.first() # Apply scale factor (MODIS LST scale = 0.02, units = Kelvin) lst_band = lst_img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02) # 4. Calculate LST for both locations # Paris (Hôtel de Ville) paris_stats = lst_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=paris_roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() paris_lst = paris_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean') paris_count = paris_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count') # Forest (Fausses-Reposes) forest_stats = lst_band.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=forest_roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() forest_lst = forest_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean') forest_count = forest_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count') print(f"Paris LST: {paris_lst}, Pixels: {paris_count}") print(f"Forest LST: {forest_lst}, Pixels: {forest_count}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if paris_count == 0 or forest_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing") print("C2") elif paris_lst is None or forest_lst is None: print("LST calculation returned None") print("C3") elif paris_lst < 200 or paris_lst > 400 or forest_lst < 200 or forest_lst > 400: print("Invalid LST values (out of reasonable range)") print("C3") else: # Convert to Celsius for readability paris_celsius = paris_lst - 273.15 forest_celsius = forest_lst - 273.15 print(f"Paris: {paris_celsius:.1f}C, Forest: {forest_celsius:.1f}C") if paris_lst < forest_lst: print("Paris LST was LOWER than forest") print("A") else: print("Paris LST was NOT lower than forest") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Hôtel de Ville, Paris (Marathon starting line)
paris_point = ee.Geometry.Point([2.3522, 48.8566])
paris_roi = paris_point.buffer(500)  # 500m buffer

# Fausses-Reposes forest (near Versailles)
forest_point = ee.Geometry.Point([2.1833, 48.8167])
forest_roi = forest_point.buffer(500)  # 500m buffer

# August 6, 2024 - looking for afternoon data
date_start = '2024-08-06'
date_end = '2024-08-07'

# 2. Try MODIS Aqua LST (afternoon overpass ~1:30 PM local)
modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])

print(f"MODIS Aqua images found: {modis_aqua.size().getInfo()}")

if modis_aqua.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Try MODIS Terra as fallback
    modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
        .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])
    
    print(f"MODIS Terra images found: {modis_terra.size().getInfo()}")
    
    if modis_terra.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No LST data available for August 6, 2024")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        collection = modis_terra
else:
    collection = modis_aqua

# 3. Process LST data
if collection.size().getInfo() > 0:
    # Get the image
    lst_img = collection.first()
    
    # Apply scale factor (MODIS LST scale = 0.02, units = Kelvin)
    lst_band = lst_img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02)
    
    # 4. Calculate LST for both locations
    # Paris (Hôtel de Ville)
    paris_stats = lst_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=paris_roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    paris_lst = paris_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean')
    paris_count = paris_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count')
    
    # Forest (Fausses-Reposes)
    forest_stats = lst_band.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=forest_roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    forest_lst = forest_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean')
    forest_count = forest_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count')
    
    print(f"Paris LST: {paris_lst}, Pixels: {paris_count}")
    print(f"Forest LST: {forest_lst}, Pixels: {forest_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if paris_count == 0 or forest_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif paris_lst is None or forest_lst is None:
        print("LST calculation returned None")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif paris_lst < 200 or paris_lst > 400 or forest_lst < 200 or forest_lst > 400:
        print("Invalid LST values (out of reasonable range)")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert to Celsius for readability
        paris_celsius = paris_lst - 273.15
        forest_celsius = forest_lst - 273.15
        
        print(f"Paris: {paris_celsius:.1f}C, Forest: {forest_celsius:.1f}C")
        
        if paris_lst < forest_lst:
            print("Paris LST was LOWER than forest")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Paris LST was NOT lower than forest")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
